title: Paniolo's Path: Malfunction to Clarity
summary: The world is tanking, its business soupy and filled with flaws. Our paniolo, leveraging her knowhows, withdraws from the chaos, wary of tricks and monstres. She discovers a sticky marker in the dirt, left by forgotten empires and atypical daemons. Neon lights cast a grim glow over a graveyard, a silent testimony to a broken caste. A primary malfunction looms, a growing obstacle of chowder-like ketchups in a lazy dystopia. But through a doorway, she finds clarity. She insists on a new path, undertaking to heal the nicks, uncorking hope for a holy, helpful world. Her journey, now durchkomponirt, begins anew.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
